description: This file defines a 'Manager' class responsible for orchestrating layout tests, including test collection, execution, server management, result processing, and reporting within a testing framework.

classes.name: Manager
classes.description: A class for managing running a series of layout tests, including setup, execution, server control, and result reporting.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the Manager with platform-specific port, options, and printer objects, setting up internal data structures.

methods.name: run
methods.description: Main method to run tests based on provided arguments, managing the entire test lifecycle and returning results.

methods.name: _collect_tests
methods.description: Finds and returns tests to run based on arguments and options.

methods.name: _is_http_test
methods.description: Determines if a test is an HTTP test based on its path.

methods.name: _is_inspector_test
methods.description: Checks if a test is an inspector test.

methods.name: _is_websocket_test
methods.description: Checks if a test is a WebSocket test.

methods.name: _http_tests
methods.description: Filters a list of test names to include only HTTP tests.

methods.name: _prepare_lists
methods.description: Prepares lists of tests to run and skip based on test paths and expectations.

methods.name: _test_input_for_file
methods.description: Creates a TestInput object for a given test file, considering timeout and expectations.

methods.name: _test_requires_lock
methods.description: Determines if a test requires locking when running multiple instances.

methods.name: _test_is_expected_missing
methods.description: Checks if a test is expected to be missing or needs rebaselining based on expectations.

methods.name: _test_is_slow
methods.description: Checks if a test is marked as slow.

methods.name: _needs_servers
methods.description: Checks if any tests require server setup.

methods.name: _rename_results_folder
methods.description: Archives previous results folder with timestamp.

methods.name: _delete_dirs
methods.description: Deletes specified directories.

methods.name: _limit_archived_results_count
methods.description: Limits the number of archived results to a predefined maximum.

methods.name: _set_up_run
methods.description: Performs build and environment checks, prepares results directory, and initializes test run.

methods.name: _run_tests
methods.description: Executes tests with specified parameters and returns results.

methods.name: _start_servers
methods.description: Starts necessary servers based on test requirements.

methods.name: _stop_servers
methods.description: Stops any servers that were started for testing.

methods.name: _clean_up_run
methods.description: Performs cleanup after test run, flushing outputs and cleaning port.

methods.name: _force_pixel_tests_if_needed
methods.description: Enables pixel tests if not already enabled.

methods.name: _look_for_new_crash_logs
methods.description: Detects and processes new crash logs after test execution.

methods.name: _clobber_old_results
methods.description: Removes old results to free space or reset state.

methods.name: _tests_to_retry
methods.description: Identifies tests that need to be retried based on previous results.

methods.name: _write_json_files
methods.description: Writes test results and statistics to JSON files.

methods.name: _upload_json_files
methods.description: Uploads JSON result files to a remote server if configured.

methods.name: _copy_results_html_file
methods.description: Copies the results HTML file to a specified destination.

methods.name: _stats_trie
methods.description: Generates a trie data structure with test statistics for reporting.
